All good, no worries :) Let me know if you change your mind.
Go to the <#1216727500487659611> channel on Discord to learn more about being a helper. If you're interested - click apply and follow instructions.

A helper helps others to complete tasks or solve quest related dilemmas on the ReShuffle discord server. It could be content oriented, technical help, or anything else - helpers are the first people to answer.

You do not need to be online all the time of course, but at least visit once every 2 days, and when you do - try to answer as many questions in your channel as you can. Also - comment and provide positive feedback to your quest-mates, the more - the merrier! 🥳

Like any community member - negative discussions and inaappropriate language are not welcome. Other then that - try to wvoid judgement and criticism, and just be as helpful and supportive as you can 💪
Hi! We saw your work and we believe you would make a great Helper 🙌 Please check out the #helper-application channel and let us know if you're inetersted 🤔
